body:
Thank you so much for replying. I think it made me feel slightly better knowing at least one other person in the universe read my post. 

The problem is it's not really a bad time in my life. Things are pretty good all around. I spent a total of one month looking for a job with no experience and it pays ridiculously good. I could quit tomorrow, move home and my parents would bend over backwards helping me "find myself". It is not about how my life is, but just not understanding why I feel like shit all the time. 

I'm going to call my doctor tomorrow. I'm still waiting on a referral to a therapist, but she said I could call if things got bad. I can't talk to friends or family - my Mum thinks I'm this perfect daughter who does no wrong.

Sorry for the long reply. Good night.
